title: OKF Attested-Computation concept (on-disk shape)
description: Documents the frontmatter shape of an AttestArc OKF 'Attested Computation' concept under scripts/computations/*.md. These concepts MODEL the kernel's deterministic, fact-emitting helper scripts (discover_repo.py, inspect_workflows.py, inspect_git_diff.py) as data. They are a DIFFERENT trust zone from the knowledge plane: they describe kernel scripts, are root-of-trust, are NEVER knowledge-attested as volatile facts, and MUST NOT live under knowledge/bootstrap/. Everything trust-relevant lives under the 'attestarc' namespace; native OKF fields (type, title) are advisory. The load-bearing invariant is 'emits: facts' — the attester (scripts/computations/attester.py) is a STRUCTURAL receipt validator only and never emits a security verdict (SPECIFICATION.md §2.6, §12.5, §17).

title.description: Advisory, human-facing label. Never read by code for a trust decision.

attestarc.description: Authoritative namespace — the only fields code reads.

id.description: Stable machine key for the computation (e.g. AC-discover-repo).

entrypoint.description: Repo-relative path to the helper script this concept models.

emits.description: Load-bearing invariant. A helper AttestArc attests MUST emit facts, never verdicts (SPECIFICATION.md §2.6/§12/§17).

read_only.description: The computation never mutates the assessed repository.

network.description: The computation never reaches the network.

executes_repo_code.description: The computation never executes repository code.

spec_ref.description: Cross-reference to the normative helper contract.

parameters.description: The computation's CLI parameters, as data.

flag.description: CLI flag, or empty string for a positional.

default.description: Default value (any JSON type, incl. null).

receipt.description: The STRUCTURAL contract of the fact receipt the computation emits — what the attester checks. It carries no data values, only the shape.

required_keys.description: Top-level keys the receipt object must contain.

key_types.description: Map of receipt key -> declared type (object|array|string|boolean|integer).

forbidden_keys.description: Verdict-shaped keys that MUST NOT appear (verdict, finding, severity, ...). Their presence makes a facts receipt structurally invalid — this is the facts-not-verdicts layer boundary, encoded as data.
